hypothesis: On AArch64, a four-lane NEON inclusive scan can compute each open row segment's dependent prefix recurrence in parallel chunks, while carrying the preceding chunk's result. Correcting the comparison-mask type should make this SIMD candidate compile without changing the modular recurrence.
notes: The prior attempt's compiler diagnostic came from using the uint32x4_t result of vcgeq_s32 with the signed vandq_s32 intrinsic. This version reinterprets the comparison mask and modulus as unsigned vectors before applying vandq_u32. Intermediate lane sums stay below INT32_MAX because operands are reduced modulo MOD. No performance result is claimed.
transformations: Fix the AArch64 modular-reduction mask operation using unsigned NEON bitwise AND with explicit vector reinterprets.
Retain the four-column NEON prefix scan, chunk carry, scalar tail, and existing blocked-cell segmentation so row dependencies and exact modular behavior are preserved.
